stem.text: Which statement about acids and bases is **always** correct?

A.text: An acid with two H atoms per molecule will be stronger than an acid with one H atom per molecule.

B.text: A concentrated solution of a strong acid will have a lower pH than a dilute solution of a weak acid.

C.text: A concentrated solution of a strong base will have a lower pH than a dilute solution of a weak base.

D.text: A strong acid is more dissociated in solution than a strong base.
